Chapter 1251 11: The Undisputed Invincible Great Saint (Seeking Base Monthly Tickets At The Beginning Of The Month)

Chapter 1251 11: The Undisputed Invincible Great Saint (Seeking Base Monthly Tickets at the Beginning of the Month)

The fate of the two Invincible Great Saints left many strong beings on the Galaxy Chaos Continent bewildered.

The revered figures cautiously observing in the nearby Void Domain were equally caught off guard.

When the Invincible Great Saints visited the Galaxy Chaos Continent, they demanded an audience with the Galaxy Great Saint. Although their demeanor was slightly arrogant, it was fitting of their status.

The strength of the Galaxy Great Saint was indeed terrifying, sweeping across the Chaos Great Saints undefeated. Yet, judging by his performance in the Xuanhuang Universe, he was still slightly short of being a true Invincible Great Saint.

But now?

Because Lin Yuan's intervention this time had the intention of establishing dominance, the scene of the obliteration of the two Invincible Great Saints was not concealed. Supreme beings could see bits and pieces, while the revered figures witnessed it clearly.

Countless strong beings watched as the terrifying aura of the two Invincible Great Saints was completely extinguished under the dazzling Fierce Sun formed by the Galaxy Great Saint.

No struggle.

No resistance.

It was as if they melted away like snow under the sun without suspense.

How can this be?

Can Invincible Great Saints be this weak?

Or is the Galaxy Great Saint too strong?

But no matter how strong, it shouldn't be possible to kill Invincible Great Saints as easily as crushing ants, right?

The revered figures felt it was somewhat absurd. Could it be that the Invincible Great Saints, whom they held in high regard in their hearts and who traversed the Chaos Void, had a day of such vulnerability?

"Were those two truly Invincible Great Saints?"

"Indeed, I have heard of their legendary names."

"How powerful is the Galaxy Great Saint, truly?"

...

The strong beings erupted into chaos after a brief silence.

Simultaneously, the scene of the Galaxy Great Saint decisively killing the two Invincible Great Saints spread swiftly through the social circles of the revered figures.

In the vast Chaos Void, battles between Invincible Great Saints were rare, let alone such one-sided domination? Could Invincible Great Saints be so thoroughly crushed, and not just one, but two?

...

The largest city on the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

The Xuanyuan Supreme and eight other human civilization supreme beings exchanged glances.

"The power of the Galaxy..." The Xuanyuan Supreme seemed to be dreaming. When the two Invincible Great Saints visited earlier, he was already shocked and worried Lin Yuan might suffer in front of them.

Who expected the Invincible Great Saints to be so weak?

"Too terrifying."

The Void God Ultimate Being was somewhat incredulous; he had realized Lin Yuan's terrifying talent since their home universe.

Indeed, Lin Yuan had led all human civilization to survive the universal apocalypse, established themselves in the Chaos Void, and now opened the Galaxy Chaos Continent, making human civilization the absolute rulers of tens of thousands of Void Domains nearby.

But now? The scene of the two Invincible Great Saints vanishing like bubbles left the Void God Ultimate Being in a daze.

Those were Invincible Great Saints.

The pinnacle beings of the Chaos Void across countless Cosmic Eras.

Yet, they were just easily destroyed by the Galaxy.

"Could the Galaxy have already entered the Thirteenth Layer?"

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being couldn't help but speak; such an easy killing of Invincible Great Saints seemed beyond what they were capable of.

"Probably not yet."

"Entering the Thirteenth Layer would surely trigger heaven-defying phenomena."

Xia Qin Supreme thought for a while and continued, "However, even if the Galaxy hasn't entered the Thirteenth Layer, his strength likely surpasses the Twelfth Layer."

The other supreme beings nodded, deeply agreeing and feeling incredibly invigorated.

Lin Yuan originated from human civilization, and the stronger he was, the more human civilization could benefit.

...

Within the dark secret realm.

The bald man's true form suddenly opened his eyes.

"This..."

The bald man was in disbelief, his mind continuously flashing back to the moment the Galaxy Great Saint, transformed into the eternal Fierce Sun, illuminated the universe, making him tremble uncontrollably.

"Too strong, too strong."

The bald man swallowed, even when facing Luo Hou Great Saint; he never felt such suffocating oppression.

Luo Hou Great Saint was indeed powerful, especially with the mastery of that Thirteenth Layer legacy, but even then, the bald man felt he could struggle and resist.

Yet facing Lin Yuan, the bald man didn't even entertain the thought of struggling.

"That Galaxy Great Saint..."

Just then, a thin figure descended, creating an avatar that sat across from the bald man.

The close relationship between the two Invincible Great Saints explained why they worked together for Luo Hou Great Saint.

"How could the Chaos Void possess such a strong being?" the bald man looked at the thin figure, expressing incredulity.

"I have no idea." The thin figure shook his head, still bewildered.

"But the Galaxy Great Saint only obliterated our main battle physical body and didn't target other avatars. It seems we're safe?" The thin figure breathed a slight sigh of relief.

"Yes."

Upon hearing this, the bald man felt confident.

Given that the Galaxy Great Saint could instantly obliterate all survival means of the Nine Phoenix Shadow Demon, he must be highly proficient in the Curse-Killing Skill. Such a being may not be capable of similarly eliminating their many avatars for survival.

He must certainly be able to precisely lock onto all their causal sources.

Locking onto causal sources, then systematically chasing and eliminating them, with the strength of the Galaxy Great Saint, the two Invincible Great Saints stand no chance of resistance.

In such a case, surviving might only be achievable through the risk-filled process of reincarnation.

Yet even for Invincible Great Saints, reincarnation involves risks, and if unsuccessful, results in endless entrapment in the cycle of rebirth, a fate worse than being caught in a time loop.

"What do we do now? And what about Luo Hou Great Saint?" the thin figure asked.
